references.text: The elders of Moab were sent as messengers to Balaam, and here the same chiefs return to Balak with Balaam's refusal.
Balaam refused to go with them because the Lord had forbidden him, as explained in the preceding verses.
Balak's response to the chiefs' report was to send even more numerous and honored envoys to Balaam.
Balaam later repeats that he cannot go against the Lord's word, not even for Balak's house full of silver and gold.
Peter mentions Balaam as an example of one who loved the wages of unrighteousness, referring to this account of Balak's attempt to hire him.
